_comment: Source of truth for requirements. Tests are linked by name pattern (fnmatch on 'tests/<file>::<test function>'). Regenerate TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md with: python quality/trace_matrix.py

requirements.title: Ink map of each page
requirements.text: The system shall rasterise each page and classify pixels darker than the ink threshold as ink, and shall compute ink totals for any window exactly (no approximation).

requirements.title: Least-ink placement
requirements.text: When no designated stamp cell exists, the system shall choose the eligible position with the least ink under the seal footprint, searching the whole eligible grid.

requirements.title: Open-space tie-break
requirements.text: Among equally inked positions the system shall prefer the one with the largest exact ink-free clearance, and shall never accept more ink for more clearance.

requirements.title: Reported coverage
requirements.text: The coverage reported for a placement shall be the fraction of ink pixels inside the circular seal footprint, and shall be stricter than or equal to the square search score.

requirements.title: Margins and page fit
requirements.text: The system shall keep the seal inside the configured page margins, shall shrink it on small pages, and shall report failure rather than place a seal that cannot fit.

requirements.title: Reserved top-right corner
requirements.text: Automatic whitespace placement shall never overlap the reserved top-right keep-out region, and a page that is entirely reserved shall be refused explicitly.

requirements.title: Designated stamp cell
requirements.text: When a page has a labelled engineer-stamp cell in real PDF text, the system shall size and centre the seal in that cell in preference to whitespace search, accepting common label spellings.

requirements.title: Every page placed, riskiest first
requirements.text: The system shall produce a placement for every page of a set and order pages by descending coverage so the operator reviews the hardest placements first.

requirements.title: Stale placements corrected, manual placements kept
requirements.text: Before output the system shall relocate stale automatic placements that violate current settings and shall never move a placement the operator set manually.

requirements.title: Operator review and override
requirements.text: The operator shall be able to move, remove and restore the seal on any page, and the downloaded PDF shall reflect exactly those decisions.

requirements.title: Original content preserved
requirements.text: By default the output PDF shall keep the original vector, text and raster content unchanged and add the seal as an overlay; rasterising the page shall be an explicit operator choice.

requirements.title: Correct position on rotated and offset pages
requirements.text: The seal shall appear upright at the displayed position on pages rotated by 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees and on pages whose origin is not (0, 0).

requirements.title: Date and caption
requirements.text: The system shall print the chosen date and caption as selectable text with the chosen size and colour, shall not silently drop the date on a small seal, and shall print no caption when the field is cleared.

requirements.title: Seal image preparation
requirements.text: The system shall make the seal's white background transparent, remove edge crop artefacts without cutting the seal, trim empty margin, and identify each seal by a content hash.

requirements.title: Cache correctness
requirements.text: Cached results shall not outlive their inputs: changing a placement setting or replacing a seal file shall refresh results, and changing only date or caption shall not recompute placements.

requirements.title: Bad input is reported, not hidden
requirements.text: An unreadable, password-protected or empty PDF shall be skipped with a stated reason, and a page analysis failure shall be reported instead of shown as zero coverage.

requirements.title: Local-only processing
requirements.text: Placement and PDF writing shall run entirely on the operator's computer; the stamper package shall not import network modules.

requirements.title: Runtime compatibility of pinned dependencies
requirements.text: The pinned Streamlit and Starlette versions shall serve preview media with correct HTTP headers under identity and gzip encoding.

requirements.title: Validation records are generated and stay current
requirements.text: The traceability matrix and the IQ/OQ execution record shall be generated from the requirements file, test names and real test results, and shall be detectably stale when a validated file changes.

requirements.title: FMEA integrity and risk traceability
requirements.text: The design/process FMEA shall score each mode with integer severity, occurrence and detection from 1 to 10, compute RPN, retain score rationale and owned actions, link exact verification tests to its requirements, and detect invalid or stale evidence without implying production approval.
